package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"
)

// Instantiations this program only REACHES: none of Box[int], Option[int],
// Pair[int, string], Wrap[Box[int]], Count[int], Node[string] is spelled
// outside a generic declaration.

type Box[T any] struct{ V T }

func Make[T any](v T) Box[T] { return Box[T]{V: v} }

type Option[T any] struct {
	ok  bool
	val T
}

func (o Option[T]) String() string {
	if o.ok {
		return fmt.Sprintf("Some(%v)", o.val)
	}
	return "None"
}

func Some[T any](val T) Option[T] { return Option[T]{ok: true, val: val} }
func None[T any]() Option[T]      { return Option[T]{ok: false} }

type Pair[K comparable, V any] struct {
	Key K
	Val V
}

func MakePair[K comparable, V any](k K, v V) Pair[K, V] { return Pair[K, V]{Key: k, Val: v} }

type Wrap[T any] struct{ Inner T }

// Nested: Wrap[Box[T]] is reached through Box[T] bound by the caller.
func Wrapped[T any](v T) Wrap[Box[T]] { return Wrap[Box[T]]{Inner: Make(v)} }

// A generic named scalar type crosses with its instantiated identity.
type Count[T any] int

func Zero[T any]() Count[T] { return 0 }

// A generic method body reaching another instantiation of its own type.
type Node[T any] struct {
	Val  T
	Next *Node[T]
}

func (n Node[T]) Chain(v T) Node[T] { return Node[T]{Val: v, Next: &n} }

func main() {
	fmt.Println(Make(1))
	fmt.Println(Some(2), None[int]())
	fmt.Println(MakePair(3, "three"))
	fmt.Println(Wrapped(4))
	fmt.Println(Zero[int]())
	head := Node[string]{Val: "a"}.Chain("b")
	fmt.Println(head.Val, head.Next.Val)
	os.Exit(3)
}
